visualCharacteristics.purpose: Section head: eyebrow and large H2 on the left, short intro paragraph aligned bottom on the right
visualCharacteristics.description: Section-head layout: wide left column with small accent-ruled eyebrow and large serif H2, narrow right column with small intro text aligned to the bottom. Same pattern in Destinations, Testimonials and on the destinations template (div.amalfi-section-head).

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: cell 1 eyebrow paragraph + H2; cell 2 intro paragraph
contentPattern.description: Fixed pair of different content side by side (eyebrow + H2 on the left, intro paragraph on the right) that never wraps: Columns. Same section-head side-by-side layout as rc2-s1.

usage.description: Section heads for Architects, Destinations and Testimonials sections, and on the destinations template (amalfi-section-head).

reuseGuidance: Use whenever a section opens with a heading on the left and a short supporting note on the right. Centered single-heading section heads stay default content.
